result.stdout:
Description:
  migrate-mongo 1.0.0-rc.1: MongoDB migrations for .NET

Usage:
  migrate-mongo [command] [options]

Options:
  -f, --file <file>               Path to the config file (default: migrate-mongo.yaml).
  -e, --env <env>                 Environment from the config file to use.
  --json                          Write machine-readable JSON lines instead of text.
  --insecure-skip-host-key-check  Don't verify the SSH tunnel server's host key (not recommended).
  --no-build                      Don't build the migrations project first.
  --runner <runner>               Run a pre-built runner (a .dll or a bundle executable) instead of building the project.
  -?, -h, --help                  Show help and usage information
  --version                       Show version information

Commands:
  init           Create a config file and a migrations project.
  create <name>  Create a new migration file.
  bundle         Publish the migrations project as a self-contained single-file executable for machines without .NET.
  version        Show the tool version.
  status         Show the state of every migration and collection definition.
  plan           Show what 'up' would do. Exits with code 2 if there is pending work.
  up             Apply pending migrations, then bring collections in line with their definitions.
  down           Roll back applied migrations.
  validate       Check applied migrations against the code (checksums, missing and out-of-order migrations).
  baseline       Record migrations as applied without running them.
  mark <id>      Manually set a migration's state.
  unlock         Remove an expired (or, with --force, any) migration lock.
  history <id>   Show the audit log.
  show <id>      Show one migration in detail: its state, results, notes, operations and history.

Description:
  Show what 'up' would do. Exits with code 2 if there is pending work.

Usage:
  migrate-mongo plan [options]

Options:
  --only <collections|migrations>      Only apply migrations, or only collection definitions (default: both).
  --allow-rebuild <allow-rebuild>      Let this index (collection.index) be dropped and created again even when onRebuild is fail. Repeat for more.
  --allow-unmatched <allow-unmatched>  Change this collection even though none of its existing indexes match the declared ones. Repeat for more.
  --allow-superseded                   Apply collection definitions that a newer run has already replaced (e.g. when rolling back on purpose).
  -?, -h, --help                       Show help and usage information
